blocks.x: Is there any closing statement that you'd like to make?
This is then the end of an oral history interview at the Concorde Hotel, February of 1982 with Erskine Hawkins.
Is there any closing statement that you'd like to make?
All I can say, I really enjoyed this and it brought back a lot of memories that I didn't want to forget, all
weaved with love. And, I'm glad I had the opportunity to be here with you on this good afternoon at the Concorde. Thanks so much for coming.
